monarch.title: Monarch Money (Optional)
monarch.description:
Optionally connect Monarch Money to track account balances and detect paychecks.

This integration uses the unofficial monarchmoney Python package (github.com/hammem/monarchmoney) to access your Monarch Money data. Your credentials are stored locally in your Home Assistant config and are only used to authenticate directly with Monarch Money. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Monarch Money.

test_monarch_success.description:
Successfully authenticated with Monarch Money. Found {account_count} accounts.

Click Submit to finish setup.

test_monarch_failed.title: Monarch Connection Failed
test_monarch_failed.description:
{error}

Click Submit to go back and try again.

monarch_auth_failed.title: Monarch Money connection failed
monarch_auth_failed.description:
HA Stock App could not authenticate with Monarch Money when this entry was set up or last reloaded. This is often caused by MFA being required but no TOTP secret configured, or credentials changing since setup. Stock price tracking is unaffected and continues normally.

To fix: open this integration's **Configure** options, re-enter your Monarch email/password (and TOTP secret if your account uses MFA), then reload the integration.

monarch_file_error.title: Monarch Money session storage error
monarch_file_error.description: HA Stock App could not read or write its Monarch Money session file. Check that Home Assistant has permission to write to its `.storage` directory, then reload the integration.
